name: What are common pitfalls to avoid during an interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid during an interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls include inadequate planning, leading to scope creep and budget overruns. Failing to secure proper permits can cause delays and legal issues. Underestimating the budget or not having a contingency fund is another frequent problem. Poor communication with your contractor or not having a clear contract can lead to misunderstandings. Lastly, making impulsive design changes during construction can significantly impact timelines and costs. Thorough preparation and clear communication are key to a smooth renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid inadequate planning, permit neglect, budget shortfalls, poor communication, and impulsive design changes to ensure a smooth renovation.
